images.title: Nine ones
images.purpose: Shows the answer to the riddle: nine digits, each 1, with digit sum 9 and digital root 9.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One row of nine equal tiles across the centre with a brace above and two short labels below.
images.exact_structure: Nine equal square teal (#0072B2) outlined tiles in one row, each holding 1. A amber (#E69F00) brace above the whole row labelled 9 digits. Under the row, two reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded tags side by side: digit sum 9 and digital root 9. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: 111111111 has 9 digits, digit sum 9 and digital root 9.
